name: Custom Threads
description: Smooth B-rep custom threads for 3D printing with presets, clearances, multi-start leads & live parameters.

preset.title: Thread Preset
preset.description: Pick an everyday/standard screw, or Auto-match from a picked face.

face.title: Cylindrical Face (optional)
face.description: Click a shaft or hole to resize & thread. Blank builds Bolt + Nut.

fdm_adjust.title: 3D Print Adjustments
fdm_adjust.description: Adds print clearance & flat tips so parts mate. Off = exact CAD.

fdm_fit.title: Clearance / Fit
fdm_fit.description: Fit feel: Tight = snug, Regular = smooth spin, Wide = easy / draft.

fdm_layer_mm.title: Layer Height (mm)
fdm_layer_mm.description: Slicer layer height (0.2 typical). Thicker layers add overhang room.

fdm_nozzle_mm.title: Nozzle Width (mm)
fdm_nozzle_mm.description: Printer nozzle (0.4 typical). Keeps tooth tips at least 1 line wide.

fdm_target.title: Mating With
fdm_target.description:
Metal: adds gap to single bolts or holes.
Printed: holes/nuts only.

opt_chamfer.title: End Chamfer
opt_chamfer.description: Lead-in bevel on thread ends so bolts catch without cross-threading.

opt_left_hand.title: Left-Hand Thread
opt_left_hand.description: Turn counter-clockwise to tighten. Off = normal right-hand.

opt_length.title: Thread Length (mm)
opt_length.description: How far threads run (mm). Blank = full face or preset length.

opt_output.title: Output
opt_output.description: Auto threads picked face, or makes Bolt + Nut. Pick to force one.

pitch.title: Pitch (mm)
pitch.description: Spacing between thread ridges (mm). Larger = chunkier, easier print.

dim_diameter.title: Diameter (mm)
dim_diameter.description: Outer width across thread peaks (mm) for standalone Bolt + Nut.

face.title: Cylindrical Face (optional)
face.description: Click shaft/hole (draw holes at bolt outer size). Blank = Bolt + Nut.

fdm_adjust.title: 3D Print Adjustments
fdm_adjust.description: On: support-free 45° walls + gap + flat tips. Off: sharp 60°.

fdm_fit.title: Clearance / Fit
fdm_fit.description: Fit feel: Tight = snug, Regular = smooth spin, Wide = easy / draft.

fdm_layer_mm.title: Layer Height (mm)
fdm_layer_mm.description: Slicer layer height (0.2 typical). Thicker layers add overhang room.

fdm_nozzle_mm.title: Nozzle Width (mm)
fdm_nozzle_mm.description: Printer nozzle (0.4 typical). Keeps tooth tips at least 1 line wide.

fdm_target.title: Mating With
fdm_target.description:
Printed: adds gap to holes/nuts only.
Metal: adds gap to shafts too.

opt_chamfer.title: End Chamfer
opt_chamfer.description: Lead-in bevel on thread ends so bolts catch without cross-threading.

opt_left_hand.title: Left-Hand Thread
opt_left_hand.description: Turn counter-clockwise to tighten. Off = normal right-hand.

opt_length.title: Thread Length (mm)
opt_length.description: How far threads run (mm). Blank = full face or 20 mm standalone.

opt_output.title: Output
opt_output.description: Auto threads picked face, or makes Bolt + Nut. Pick to force one.

opt_starts.title: Starts (Multi-Track)
opt_starts.description: Parallel spirals. 1 = normal screw; 2-4 = quick-twist jar/cap lids.

pitch.title: Pitch (mm)
pitch.description: Spacing between thread ridges (mm). Larger = chunkier. Exact values.

dim_diameter.title: Diameter (mm)
dim_diameter.description: Outer width across thread peaks (mm) for standalone Bolt + Nut.

dim_left_hand.title: Left-Hand Thread
dim_left_hand.description: Turn counter-clockwise to tighten. Off = normal right-hand.

dim_length.title: Thread Length (mm)
dim_length.description: How far threads run (mm). Blank = full face or 20 mm standalone.

dim_starts.title: Starts
dim_starts.description: Parallel spirals. 1 = normal screw; 2-4 = quick-twist jar/cap lids.

face.title: Cylindrical Face (optional)
face.description: Click shaft/hole (draw holes at bolt outer size). Blank = Bolt + Nut.

flank_lower_deg.title: Lower Flank Angle (deg)
flank_lower_deg.description: Bottom tooth slope. 45° support-free; 30° standard; vary = buttress.

flank_upper_deg.title: Upper Flank Angle (deg)
flank_upper_deg.description: Top tooth slope. 45° prints support-free; 30° matches 60° metal.

gap_axial_clr.title: Axial Backlash (mm)
gap_axial_clr.description: Up-and-down play along screw. Higher = freer spin (0.1 mm typical).

gap_mating.title: Mating With
gap_mating.description:
Printed: adds gap to holes/nuts only.
Metal: shrinks single shafts too.

gap_radial_clr.title: Radial Clearance (mm)
gap_radial_clr.description: Side-to-side bolt/nut gap. Higher = looser fit (0.2 mm typical).

opt_chamfer.title: End Chamfer
opt_chamfer.description: Lead-in bevel on thread ends so bolts catch without cross-threading.

opt_chamfer_mm.title: Chamfer Size (mm)
opt_chamfer_mm.description: Optional exact bevel width (mm). Blank uses End Chamfer above.

opt_nut_wall.title: Nut Wall (mm)
opt_nut_wall.description: Wall thickness around generated nut. Thicker resists cracking.

opt_output.title: Output
opt_output.description: Auto threads picked face, or makes Bolt + Nut. Pick to force one.

opt_pair_spacing.title: Pair Spacing (mm)
opt_pair_spacing.description: Gap between generated Bolt & Nut (0 stacks them to check fit).

opt_param_prefix.title: Parameter Prefix
opt_param_prefix.description: Optional short tag (e.g. cap) for parameters; blank = t1, t2...

tooth_crest_fillet.title: Crest Fillet (mm)
tooth_crest_fillet.description: Rounds tooth peaks for smooth feel. 0 = flat; >0 to tune in Edit.

tooth_crest_flat.title: Crest Flat (mm)
tooth_crest_flat.description: Flat width on tooth peaks. Keep >= nozzle (0.4) so tips print solid.

tooth_root_fillet.title: Root Fillet (mm)
tooth_root_fillet.description: Rounds valley corners for strength. 0 = sharp; >0 to tune in Edit.

tooth_root_flat.title: Root Flat (mm)
tooth_root_flat.description: Flat width at valley bottoms. Wider = stronger groove (0.4 typical).

target.title: Target Thread (optional)
target.description: Pick a threaded face/body to edit (Timeline folder shows values). Blank fields stay as-is.

param_prefix.title: Parameter Prefix
param_prefix.description: Thread tag from Timeline (e.g. t1) if not picked; blank edits latest.

pitch.title: Pitch (mm)
pitch.description: Spacing between thread ridges (mm). Larger = coarser teeth.

length.title: Length (mm)
length.description: How far the threads run along the shaft or hole (mm).

starts.title: Starts
starts.description: Parallel thread spirals (1 = normal bolt, 2-4 = quick-twist).

left_hand.title: Left-Hand Thread
left_hand.description: Switch between normal right-hand and counter-clockwise left-hand.

upper_flank_angle_deg.title: Upper Flank (deg)
upper_flank_angle_deg.description: Top tooth wall slope (45° easy print, 30° standard 60° bolt).

lower_flank_angle_deg.title: Lower Flank (deg)
lower_flank_angle_deg.description: Bottom tooth wall slope (45° easy print, 30° standard bolt).

radial_clearance.title: Radial Clearance (mm)
radial_clearance.description: Side-to-side gap between bolt & nut. Higher = looser fit.

axial_clearance.title: Axial Backlash (mm)
axial_clearance.description: Up-and-down play along the screw. Higher = freer spin.

crest_flat.title: Crest Flat (mm)
crest_flat.description: Flat width on tooth peaks (keep >= nozzle width).

root_flat.title: Root Flat (mm)
root_flat.description: Flat width at valley bottoms (wider = stronger).

crest_fillet.title: Crest Fillet (mm)
crest_fillet.description: Peak corner rounding (only editable if created >0).

root_fillet.title: Root Fillet (mm)
root_fillet.description: Valley corner rounding (only editable if created >0).

end_chamfer.title: End Chamfer
end_chamfer.description: Lead-in bevel on ends (Regular, Wide, or None).

chamfer_mm.title: Chamfer Size (mm)
chamfer_mm.description: Exact lead-in bevel width (mm); overrides End Chamfer.

nut_wall_thickness.title: Nut Wall (mm)
nut_wall_thickness.description: Wall thickness around a standalone nut (mm).

pair_spacing.title: Pair Spacing (mm)
pair_spacing.description: Gap between standalone Bolt & Nut (0 = stacked together).
